tariffs.method: Use the September customer liability as cumulative net pass-through receipts because FedEx recognizes the liability when it receives cash and relieves the liability when it pays customers. Interpret the outlook's customer refund adjustment as the expected full-year net pass-through balance. The model excludes this pass-through from available cash. Recoveries retained by FedEx stay in operating cash because their separate cash effects are unavailable.

timing.method: Null shares spread the modeled Q4 total uniformly by elapsed calendar days. FedEx did not disclose exact timing for these cash flows. Allocate the Supply Chain sale by its actual October 1 closing date.
